user_visible_outcome: No user-visible change. The database security tests can no longer pass CI without executing: CI provisions a real database and runs every RLS test for real, failing the build if the database is unreachable.
design: CI job gains a postgis/postgis:16-3.4 service (PG15+ required for security_invoker views; PostGIS required by migration 03 geometry). A checked-in bootstrap creates only the primitives vanilla Postgres lacks (anon/authenticated roles, auth.uid() reading request.jwt.claims with Supabase-compatible null-when-absent semantics), refuses to run against a real Supabase stack, and is idempotent. Migrations apply in filename order, then the unchanged verify:all path runs tests 01-07. REQUIRE_SUPABASE_TESTS=1 turns any skip into a build failure in CI; local runs without a database keep the loud skip notice. verify-supabase.sh honors DATABASE_URL and probes with psql itself instead of requiring pg_isready.
files_changed: .github/workflows/ci.yml (postgres service, DATABASE_URL + REQUIRE_SUPABASE_TESTS=1 env, psql client install, bootstrap + ordered-migration prepare step)
tools/supabase-ci-bootstrap.sql (new: roles, auth.uid() stub, anti-Supabase-stack guard; no product objects, no privilege grants)
tools/verify-supabase.sh (DATABASE_URL support, psql self-probe, REQUIRE flag turning skip into failure)
docs/REGISTRY_MIGRATION_NOTES.md (migration 08 entry, manual loop extended to 07, CI gate section)
